Korean Bibimbap
Prep time: 30 minutes | Cook time: 25 minutes
Makes 4 servings

For the rice:
2 cups short-grain rice

For the beef:
300g ground beef
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp sugar
1 tbsp sesame oil
2 cloves garlic, minced

Vegetables:
200g spinach
200g bean sprouts
1 carrot, julienned
1 zucchini, julienned

To serve:
4 eggs
4 tbsp gochujang
1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds
2 tbsp vegetable oil, for frying
Salt to taste

Method
Cook the rice. Marinate the beef in soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil and garlic for 15 minutes.
Blanch the spinach and bean sprouts, then season each with a pinch of salt.
Fry the eggs sunny side up and arrange everything over the rice.
